control_plane_hardening_items.detail: product-reality-check.yml fires only on a push to lab/product whose head commit message contains '[reality-check]'. The core-lane integrate job is the only automation that pushes to lab/product, and its commit message is 'accept product cycle <id>', which never carries the marker. No workflow with workflow_dispatch exists for it, and the file is not on main. Therefore a durable Product Reality Check run cannot be produced through the audit+integrate chain as currently configured.
candidate_fixes: core-lane.yml integrate: append ' [reality-check]' to the accept commit message when lane == product
or: add workflow_dispatch to product-reality-check.yml and publish it on main
